about.title: Small tools you can use with confidence
about.description: Our priority is making complex document, video, audio and image tasks easy to complete while keeping your work private.
about.localTitle: Your files stay on your device
about.localDescription: Selected files, passwords and results are not sent to our server. Working data disappears when you close the browser tab.

items.uploadDescription: Files and passwords are handled only inside your browser.
items.accountDescription: You do not need to sign in or provide personal details.
items.transparentDescription: Each processing step and supported scope is explained up front.

about.appearanceDescription: Light and dark mode follow your operating-system setting automatically.

contact.title: Contact, ideas & bug reports
contact.description: We review bug reports and feature suggestions through our public developer channel.
contact.githubTitle: Tell us about bugs and improvements
contact.githubDescription: Include reproduction steps, your browser, the file format and the exact error shown on screen so we can investigate.
contact.ideaDescription: Tell us which file task you repeat and the input and output you need. Replace personal or confidential company data with sample data.
contact.privacyDescription: Do not include file names, original documents or real passwords. Redact sensitive content from screenshots before sharing.
contact.reportTitle: Useful details for a bug report
reportItems: Operating system and browser name and version
The file format where the problem occurred
The merge, comparison, conversion, encoding or image-editing mode and scope you selected
The last progress-log step and exact error
A minimal, redacted reproduction file only when it is safe to share

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.description: How local file processing differs from network requests used to operate this site.
privacy.principle: Documents, file passwords and generated results are not uploaded to or stored on a Worklazy Tools server.

sections.title: 1. Information processed in your browser
paragraphs: Files selected for document, PDF, video, audio and image tools are read and processed in your browser. Text, payroll, employment dates and passwords are calculated in the current page and browser memory.
items: Input files and passwords are used only during the task
Results are offered through temporary browser download URLs
Text, payroll and password inputs are not sent to a server or permanently stored
Ordinary task state disappears on reload or tab close; the official rhwp editor may keep a local recovery draft in IndexedDB

sections.title: 2. Local workers and memory transfer
paragraphs: EXIF removal, QR image scanning, table conversion and other heavy operations run in task-specific browser workers that are stopped after completion. Audio PCM, editing history and the page clipboard remain in the current tab.

When an MP3 or AAC result is continued in Audio Studio, its Blob is transferred once in memory to a same-origin tab, the communication channel is closed, and the output is not placed in persistent browser storage.

sections.title: 3. Ordinary network information
paragraphs: Loading this static site and the analytics or advertising services below can expose ordinary request information such as IP address, browser type and request time to GitHub Pages and those providers. This is separate from work-file contents.

sections.title: 4. Self-hosted editing and processing components
paragraphs: Official rhwp JavaScript, WebAssembly, UI and fonts are bundled as pinned static assets. HWP files move to the same-site editor iframe through an in-browser MessageChannel, not an upload request.
Word comparison, PDF OCR and FFmpeg runtimes are served from this GitHub Pages deployment. A first offline visit cannot start features whose runtime is not yet cached.

sections.title: 5. Google and Naver Analytics; Google AdSense
paragraphs: Google Analytics 4 and Naver Analytics can process page paths, referrals, visit and click times, and browser or device categories. Tool-menu events contain only the tool identifier and menu location.

File names, contents and sizes, entered text, payroll and passwords, QR results, generated output and detailed errors are not included in analytics events. Google Signals and ad personalization are disabled in Google Analytics.

Google AdSense and advertising partners may use cookies, web beacons, IP addresses and identifiers for ad delivery, measurement and abuse prevention. Video Studio does not load AdSense scripts, but with consent it uses the same limited visit analytics as other pages. Selected videos, trim ranges, and output settings are not included in analytics events.

sections.title: 6. Consent and third parties
paragraphs: Google and Naver analytics and Google AdSense scripts are not loaded before consent, and Google Consent Mode defaults analytics and advertising storage to denied. You can reopen the choice from Analytics & ad settings in the footer. When ads are served in the EEA, United Kingdom or Switzerland, the site's Google-certified CMP setting is used as well.

Browser settings and content blockers can limit analytics or advertising without disabling local file processing. Worklazy Tools does not sell selected files or passwords or provide them to analytics or advertising companies. Third-party processing of ordinary connection data follows their policies and your consent settings.

sections.title: 7. Children, updates and contact
paragraphs: The service targets general work users and does not offer accounts or forms intended to collect information from children under 14. This policy and its effective date may be updated when features, providers or applicable law change. Never attach real work documents or passwords to a privacy inquiry.

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.description: Supported scope and safe-use conditions for these browser tools.

sections.title: 1. Purpose and permitted use
paragraphs: Worklazy Tools provides free browser utilities for documents, media, text, data, work planning, Korean payroll, privacy and sharing. Use only files you are authorized to process, comply with applicable law, and do not disrupt the service or distribute malicious files.

sections.title: 2. Intellectual property
paragraphs: Using the official site does not transfer rights to Worklazy-authored code, UI, documentation or original visual assets. Without written permission you may not copy or redistribute a substantial part, mirror or rehost it as a substitute service, monetize a copy, remove notices, or imply official affiliation. Third-party open-source components remain governed by their own licenses.

sections.title: 3. Backups and result verification
paragraphs: Keep important originals and verify generated results in the appropriate application before use. Browser output can differ from Microsoft Office, Hangul, media players or desktop image editors.
items: Macros, images, links, pivots and advanced spreadsheet objects may be omitted or simplified
Complex Word fields, numbering, shapes, comments and merged tables can differ from Microsoft Word comparison
PDF conversion infers reading order and tables from coordinates; OCR can contain errors
Editing a PDF invalidates existing digital signatures and may omit forms or bookmarks
HWP rendering and saving follow the current official rhwp feature boundary
MKV, AVI, HEVC and copied audio streams are not universally compatible
M4A, AAC and OGG decoding depends on the browser and device
HEIC and HEIF are unsupported; OffscreenCanvas features require iOS 16.4 or later
Korean writing checks and South Korean workday, leave and payroll calculations are reference estimates
Password crack-time estimates are comparative; QR destinations are not safety-checked

sections.title: 4. Changes, availability and liability
paragraphs: Features may change or pause because of browser, hosting or maintenance conditions. The service is provided as-is. Except where law requires otherwise or in cases of intent or gross negligence, Worklazy Tools is not liable for indirect loss caused by file damage, missing output, compatibility or use without verification.

sections.title: 5. Analytics, advertising and changes to these terms
paragraphs: Analytics, advertising and external links follow the Privacy Policy and each provider's terms. When operating conditions change, these terms and the effective date may be updated; legally required consent will be requested separately.
